title: glass wine glasses
text: glass wine glasses. Purchased these to replace some plastic ones in a gift picnic backpack.  They fit and feel a bit tougher than you could think.  Of course time will tell.  Each one has a clear, different colored stem.  I think they look perfect in the picnic backpack.

product_metadata.title: Red Co. Cocktail Glasses or Wine Goblets with Colorful Stems - Set of 4
features: These glasses are great for brunches, dinner parties, and holiday gatherings.
The delicate make of this set is a striking addition to any table, with the colorful stems creating a bold twist on traditional cocktail glasses.
An easy gift choice that appeals to a wide audience and perfect for birthdays, newlyweds, and housewarming parties.
The unique shape is a playful and modern update to the traditionally shaped wine glass.
Set of 4. Glasses measure approximately 2.75" in diameter with a height of 4.5" - Dishwasher safe - Holds up to 6oz
